post_tool_reply.semantics: Only successful decision_action=final after an executed tool is reply writing. ask_user/questionnaire and further tool selection are separate. Shares use completed runs with known reply timing and the observed trace span, not user-perceived latency; failed runs and absent timings are excluded from shares, retained in counts.

warnings: specialist_worker: only 1 timed operations; p95 is a descriptive small-sample statistic.
summary_compaction: only 3 timed operations; p95 is a descriptive small-sample statistic.
semantics: Durations include failures and internal retries; model_retry is not an extra decision.
Decision counts are logical decide() calls; provider_request_count uses attempt_count to include internal retries when available.
Tool execution is inclusive of nested workers/embedding; phase totals must not be added.
Embedding measures one embed() operation including its batches; startup warmup outside a turn is excluded.
Summary timing covers summarize() including validation, not the entire context load/commit.
Observed trace span excludes time before the first event; it is not end-to-end response latency.
Per-run counts include zero-use runs; duration totals exclude runs with missing phase timings.
Context cohorts use the first decision context_chars, not the full serialized request token count.

post_tool_response_message.semantics: Successful final or ask_user after an executed tool. ask_user can be an answer with a follow-up or a needed clarification; it is not necessarily successful task completion. Further tool selection, questionnaire and failed decisions are separate. Shares include only completed runs with known response timings; denominator is trace span, not first-card or end-to-end user latency. Completed turns with fully paired decision telemetry and no response call contribute a true zero. Incomplete or unknown telemetry is not imputed as zero; conditional shares among reply runs are also reported.

capture_wall_time.semantics: Denominator is capture run_turn() wall time, including context load/commit. Only exact sequential conversation joins are accepted. Runtime completion is not task-success grading. Failed/unknown timing is excluded from shares; proven no-writer runtime refusals are retained as zero.
